aclEvidence: No real Windows NTFS/ACL acceptance evidence is included in the 2.0.4 limited-trust profile; it remains required before any Windows/NTFS or full-assurance claim.
executablePolicy: Windows consumers authenticate file bytes and signed POSIX intent but do not claim that NTFS stores POSIX executable bits.
posixModeAuthority: The signed integrity manifest is the authenticated portability intent used for deterministic comparison on Windows.
residualRisk: A principal able to rewrite the protected launcher, configuration, checkpoint, runtime, or destination ACL remains outside the repository-only threat boundary.
